title.zh: ESMA就MiCA下不合规稳定币与DeFi规则提出意见并设定退出期限
title.en: ESMA Proposes MiCA Rules for DeFi Gateways, Staking and Lending

current_state.zh: ESMA要求欧盟监管机构确保获得MiCA牌照的加密公司停止所有涉及不合规稳定币的服务，并设定2027年1月8日为清退现有敞口的硬性截止日期。
current_state.en: ESMA told EU regulators to ensure MiCA-licensed crypto firms halt all services involving non-compliant stablecoins, setting a hard deadline of Jan. 8, 2027 to wind down existing exposures.

updates.title_zh: ESMA 提议针对 DeFi 网关、质押和借贷的 MiCA 规则
updates.title_en: ESMA Proposes MiCA Rules for DeFi Gateways, Staking and Lending
updates.what_changed_zh: ESMA 提议的 MiCA 规则将要求 DeFi 网关、质押和借贷服务获得牌照，并禁止加密公司提供涉及不合规稳定币的 MiCA 可许可服务。
updates.what_changed_en: ESMA proposed MiCA rules that would require licensing for DeFi gateways, staking, and lending services and bar crypto firms from offering MiCA-licensable services involving noncompliant stablecoins.
updates.current_state_zh: ESMA 提议的 MiCA 规则将要求 DeFi 网关、质押和借贷服务获得牌照，并禁止加密公司提供涉及不合规稳定币的 MiCA 可许可服务。
updates.current_state_en: ESMA proposed MiCA rules that would require licensing for DeFi gateways, staking, and lending services and bar crypto firms from offering MiCA-licensable services involving noncompliant stablecoins.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: ESMA proposed MiCA rules that would require licensing for DeFi gateways, staking, and lending services and bar crypto firms from offering MiCA-licensable services involving noncompliant stablecoins.
updates.detailed_summary_en: ESMA proposed MiCA rules that would require licensing for DeFi gateways, staking, and lending services and bar crypto firms from offering MiCA-licensable services involving noncompliant stablecoins.

updates.title_zh: ESMA 提议终止欧盟对不合规稳定币的托管和转账服务
updates.title_en: ESMA proposes ending EU custody and transfer services for non-compliant stablecoins
updates.what_changed_zh: ESMA 2026年9月30日的MiCA审查回应进一步提议将不合规稳定币限制扩展至托管和转移服务，可能使现有持有者在交易对下架后失去持牌托管人的服务渠道。
updates.what_changed_en: ESMA's September 30, 2026 MiCA review response further proposes extending non-compliant stablecoin restrictions to custody and transfer services, potentially removing licensed-custodian access for existing holders after trading pairs are delisted.
updates.current_state_zh: ESMA提议的MiCA规则要求DeFi网关、质押和借贷服务获得许可，禁止加密公司提供涉及不合规稳定币的MiCA可许可服务，并进一步提议将限制扩展至不合规稳定币的托管和转移服务。
updates.current_state_en: ESMA proposed MiCA rules requiring licensing for DeFi gateways, staking and lending services, barring crypto firms from offering MiCA-licensable services involving non-compliant stablecoins, and further proposing to extend restrictions to custody and transfer services for non-compliant stablecoins.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: ESMA has proposed extending MiCA restrictions on non-compliant stablecoins to custody and transfer services, which would strip EU holders of licensed-custodian access to those tokens once their trading pairs are removed.
updates.detailed_summary_en: ESMA has proposed extending MiCA restrictions on non-compliant stablecoins to custody and transfer services, which would strip EU holders of licensed-custodian access to those tokens once their trading pairs are removed.

updates.title_zh: ESMA提议终止对不合规稳定币的欧盟托管和转账服务
updates.title_en: ESMA proposes ending EU custody and transfer services for non-compliant stablecoins
updates.what_changed_zh: ESMA提议终止对不合规稳定币的欧盟托管和转账服务，收紧对在欧盟运营的稳定币发行方和服务提供商的MiCA规则执行。
updates.what_changed_en: ESMA has proposed ending EU custody and transfer services for non-compliant stablecoins, tightening enforcement of MiCA rules on stablecoin issuers and service providers operating in the bloc.
updates.current_state_zh: ESMA提议终止对不合规稳定币的欧盟托管和转账服务，收紧对在欧盟运营的稳定币发行方和服务提供商的MiCA规则执行。
updates.current_state_en: ESMA has proposed ending EU custody and transfer services for non-compliant stablecoins, tightening enforcement of MiCA rules on stablecoin issuers and service providers operating in the bloc.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: ESMA has proposed ending EU custody and transfer services for non-compliant stablecoins, tightening enforcement of MiCA rules on stablecoin issuers and service providers operating in the bloc.
updates.detailed_summary_en: ESMA has proposed ending EU custody and transfer services for non-compliant stablecoins, tightening enforcement of MiCA rules on stablecoin issuers and service providers operating in the bloc.

updates.title_zh: ESMA给加密公司3个月时间退出不合规稳定币
updates.title_en: ESMA gives crypto firms 3 months to exit non-compliant stablecoins
updates.what_changed_zh: ESMA要求欧盟监管机构确保获得MiCA牌照的加密公司停止所有涉及不合规稳定币的服务，并设定2027年1月8日为清退现有敞口的硬性截止日期。
updates.what_changed_en: ESMA told EU regulators to ensure MiCA-licensed crypto firms halt all services involving non-compliant stablecoins, setting a hard deadline of Jan. 8, 2027 to wind down existing exposures.
updates.current_state_zh: ESMA要求欧盟监管机构确保获得MiCA牌照的加密公司停止所有涉及不合规稳定币的服务，并设定2027年1月8日为清退现有敞口的硬性截止日期。
updates.current_state_en: ESMA told EU regulators to ensure MiCA-licensed crypto firms halt all services involving non-compliant stablecoins, setting a hard deadline of Jan. 8, 2027 to wind down existing exposures.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: ESMA told EU regulators to ensure MiCA-licensed crypto firms halt all services involving non-compliant stablecoins, setting a hard deadline of Jan. 8, 2027 to wind down existing exposures.
updates.detailed_summary_en: ESMA told EU regulators to ensure MiCA-licensed crypto firms halt all services involving non-compliant stablecoins, setting a hard deadline of Jan. 8, 2027 to wind down existing exposures.

updates.title_zh: 【ESMA 要求欧盟加密企业 3 个月内停止非合规稳定币服务】
updates.title_en: 【ESMA 要求欧盟加密企业 3 个月内停止非合规稳定币服务】
updates.what_changed_zh: ESMA发布意见，要求欧盟加密企业在三个月内停止涉及不合规稳定币的服务，并设定2027年1月8日为各国监管机构完成风险敞口处理的最后期限；该意见扩展了2025年1月的指引，将适用范围扩大至交易平台、兑换、订单执行、托管、转账、投资建议与投资组合管理等所有MiCA监管服务。
updates.what_changed_en: ESMA issued an opinion requiring EU crypto firms to cease services involving non-compliant stablecoins within three months, setting a January 8, 2027 deadline for national regulators to wind down remaining exposures; the opinion expands January 2025 guidance to cover all MiCA-regulated crypto services including trading platforms, exchange, order execution, custody, transfer, investment advice and portfolio management.
updates.current_state_zh: ESMA已发布意见，要求欧盟加密企业在2027年1月8日前停止涉及不合规稳定币的服务，各国监管机构将据此执行，允许有限临时服务用于客户退出头寸。
updates.current_state_en: ESMA has issued an opinion requiring EU crypto firms to cease services involving non-compliant stablecoins by January 8, 2027, with national regulators expected to enforce; limited temporary services are allowed for clients to exit positions.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: ESMA issued an opinion requiring EU crypto firms to cease services involving MiCA-non-compliant stablecoins within three months, giving national regulators a deadline of 8 January 2027 to have remaining exposures wound down.
updates.detailed_summary_en: ESMA issued an opinion requiring EU crypto firms to cease services involving MiCA-non-compliant stablecoins within three months, giving national regulators a deadline of 8 January 2027 to have remaining exposures wound down.
